newsitem.title: UK: AVGE DISCOUNT RATE AT UK 91-DAY BILL TENDER 6.7800.
newsitem.headline: AVGE DISCOUNT RATE AT UK 91-DAY BILL TENDER 6.7800.

text.p: The average rate of discount at the weekly tender of 91-day UK Treasury bills rose to 6.7800 percent from 6.7348 last week, the Bank of England said on Friday.
The 200 million stg offer attracted bids of 1.031 billion stg. The pro rata price was 98.300.
The Bank also auctioned 300 million stg of 28-day bills at an average rate of discount of 6.8438 percent up from 6.7134 percent.
